entities.name: Martin Luther
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: German theologian and Augustinian friar (1483–1546) whose Ninety-Five Theses in 1517 challenged papal indulgences and ignited the Protestant Reformation. His doctrines of sola fide (by faith alone) and sola scriptura (by Scripture alone) fundamentally split Western Christianity.
